response.query: SELECT r."numericId" as id, r.title, r."fileUrl" as url, u."displayName" as prof_name, s."nameFr" as subject, c."nameFr" as class, sec."nameFr" as section FROM "Resource" r LEFT JOIN "User" u ON r."teacherId" = u.id LEFT JOIN "Subject" s ON r."subjectId" = s.id LEFT JOIN "Class" c ON r."classId" = c.id LEFT JOIN "Section" sec ON r."sectionId" = sec.id WHERE r."numericId" IN (11358, 4139)
